name: Rope Pressdown
instructions: Attach a rope to a high pulley and grip the ends.
Keep your elbows pinned at your sides.
Press the rope down until your arms are straight, spreading the ends.
cues: Spread the rope at the bottom
longevityNotes: Pressing strength keeps daily pushing — doors, shelves, getting up from the floor — easy and safe. Controlled pressing builds the shoulders, chest, and arms that protect you in a fall.
overview: A cable triceps pressdown with a rope that lets you spread the ends at the bottom.
